title: Vice President Data Operations - Transformation & Automation
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
MSCI is a leading provider of investment decision support tools to clients worldwide, ranging from large pension plans to boutique hedge funds. We offer a range of products and services - including indexes, portfolio risk and performance analytics
  
  
The
**MSCI Data Collection team**
sources ESG and Climate raw input data from publicly available sources and validates Private Assets data, including financials, industry classification, geography, and sustainability exposures for Private Capital Solutions. The team manages data production, ensures quality control, and collaborates with global teams, content teams, and product teams to maintain accuracy and adherence to MSCI’s data collection methodology. This role focuses on leveraging AI and technology to drive innovation, enhance operational efficiencies, and solve client challenges at scale in collaboration with Data, Engineering, and Project Management teams. Responsibilities include hiring and onboarding analysts, managing multiple datasets, and ensuring compliance with dataset policies and quality standards. As a subject matter expert, the lead will drive best practices in data management, automation, and integration while establishing “Factory” data operations to enhance the speed, accuracy, and scalability of data delivery.
  
  

* Govern private assets data acquisition by consulting on data collection practices, overseeing governance, and driving system development to meet “Data Factory” requirements.
* Establish data governance best practices for SLA management, new data acquisition, and existing process management.
* Possess strong subject knowledge of global markets, businesses, financial products, including equities, corporate actions, private assets, and private equity funds.
* Transform data operations for scalability and quality enhancement by implementing next-generation data acquisition flows using cloud-native solutions.
* Develop data solutions by collaborating with extended collection, content, research, and product teams to evaluate new methodologies, define requirements, and provide practical feasibility recommendations.
* Lead automation of operational processes through hands-on tactical automation and full-scale production implementation.
* Accelerate input data factualization for Private Assets/ESG, ensuring objective data collection methods that improve operational transparency

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Team & Leadership Responsibilities
* Recruit, onboard, and develop team members to build a high-performing workforce.
* Accomplish function objectives by managing staff, planning, and evaluating functional activities.
* Ensure team productivity, data quality, and timelines adhere to the highest established SLA standards.
* Develop strategic plans, goals, and objectives ensuring alignment with function and company priorities.
* Process Optimization & Automation
* Optimize processes through AI, automation, and technology to enhance efficiency and scalability.
* Work on automating repetitive processes to increase efficiency and team throughput.
* Drive automation of manual processes through hands-on tactical implementation and end-state solutions in production.
* Implement best practices for workflow automation and next-generation data acquisition.
* Transform existing data operations for scalability and improved quality.
* Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Monitoring
* Use a data-driven approach to solve complex and business-critical problems.
* Define and track key metrics to monitor, analyze, and improve processes and performance.
* Leverage data-driven insights to solve business challenges and improve operational effectiveness.
* Business Transformation & Continuous Improvement
* Scale the business through standardization, lean practices, and continuous improvement.
* Standardize operations through process reengineering and transformation initiatives.
* Lead business transformation initiatives, driving automation from tactical implementation to end-state solutions.
* Advocate for new ideas and process improvements to close gaps, reduce manual efforts, and enhance the customer experience.
* Stakeholder & Compliance Management
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including content and engineering, to enhance workflow solutions.
* Inform, influence, negotiate, and persuade internal/external stakeholders on continuous improvement efforts and initiatives.
* Design solutions using rigorous process improvement and change management methodologies.
* Identify implications of proposed solutions on people, processes, technology, strategy, and structure.
* Ensure adherence to compliance, security, and regulatory standards while mitigating risks and maintaining operational resilience.
* Strategic & Market Insights
* Ensure operational strategies align with overall business objectives, driving efficiency, scalability, and innovation.
* Leverage market insights and competitive intelligence to drive process innovation and enhance customer experience.
* Define and execute the AI & automation strategy to optimize operations, enhance decision-making, and drive efficiency gains

**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

* 14+ years of experience in Operations/Team Management, Process Optimization, Design Thinking, Agile, Robotics Process Automation, Project & Change Management.
* 5+ years of people management experience, including leading teams and driving performance.
* Proven operations transformation experience supported by quantitative metrics.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, cross-functional teams, and external partners to drive strategic initiatives.
* Experience working through ambiguity and lack of structure while driving consensus across various stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with programming languages/tools (Python, Power Automate, Power BI preferred).
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify anomalies.
* Understanding of AI/ML applications in business operations and experience in implementing AI-driven solutions to optimize workflows.
* Solid experience in large-scale business process re-engineering and transformation.
* Strong customer-centric approach to ensure operational improvements enhance the end-user experience.
* Ability to run basic financials, cost-benefit analyses, and build business cases for new projects.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with expertise in stakeholder management.
* Startup mindset – ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our purpose – to power better investment decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI is a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment community. With over 50 years of expertise in research, data, and technology, we power better investment decisions by enabling clients to understand and analyze key drivers of risk and return and confidently build more effective portfolios. We create industry-leading research-enhanced solutions that clients use to gain insight into and improve transparency across the investment process.

We are looking for a visionary Engineering leader who will be responsible for building and leading a world-class team of software engineers to drive end-to-end technical design, platform innovation, and execution across multiple on-premises and cloud-native SaaS applications. ***Product & Platform Engineering***

* Drive the Agentic AI strategy for the engineering organization — identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI agents across product workflows, developer tooling, and customer-facing capabilities.

* Partner with Product Management to define AI-powered features that create meaningful differentiation and deliver measurable customer value.

* Work with senior engineering leaders to formulate and execute comprehensive technology roadmaps aligned with company strategy and market direction.
* Collaborate across the organization to craft and deliver solutions that consistently exceed customer expectations.
* Drive the transition to feature-based, on-demand release models — enabling greater delivery velocity, release predictability, and customer alignment.
* Partner with Security, DevOps, and SRE teams to ensure platform reliability, security posture, and compliance standards are maintained at the highest level.

***Experience & Leadership***

* 20+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with a significant portion in senior engineering leadership roles.
* Proven track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams, with a strong focus on driving innovation, accountability, and results.
* Experience working in a product development company in the Application Security, Identity, or Infrastructure domain is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, build from the ground up, and deliver in fast-moving, high-growth environments.

***Technical Depth***

* Deep expertise in SaaS architecture, microservices, Kubernetes, MongoDB, and cloud-native application development.

* Full working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, software engineering principles, design patterns, and enterprise product development practices.

* Strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem-solving, and Computer Science fundamentals.
* Proponent of TDD and CI — capable of inspiring and motivating teams to adopt and sustain these practices.

***Leadership & Communication***

* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — with the ability to operate with clarity and conviction across engineering teams, executive leadership, and customers.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with a bias for action in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
* Results-oriented with the ability to balance long-term strategic vision with near-term execution and delivery.

AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. About Elimai.ai

Elimai.ai is an AI-native enterprise technology company building intelligent AI agents for the fashion and apparel industry.

Our platform helps apparel manufacturers and exporters streamline product development, sampling, costing, pre-production approvals, and merchandising workflows. By automating email processing, technical document interpretation, approval tracking, and manual Excel updates, we help teams improve productivity, reduce errors, and gain real-time operational visibility.

We are now expanding our solutions to support fashion brands, buying offices, and sourcing organizations, enabling seamless collaboration across the fashion supply chain.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Apparel Product Development & Merchandising Domain Specialist**
with strong knowledge of garment product development, sourcing, technical merchandising, and brand-side operations.

This is a domain expertise and product development role, not a conventional merchandising execution position. The selected candidate will work closely with our product, AI, and engineering teams to translate real-world apparel industry workflows into intelligent software solutions.

We are looking for someone who understands not only
**what merchandisers do, but why they do it, how decisions are made, and where existing processes can be improved.**

Why Join Elimai.ai?

* Contribute directly to AI products built specifically for the apparel industry.
* Work closely with product leaders and AI engineering teams.
* Apply real-world merchandising experience to solve industry-wide operational challenges.
* Help shape technology for fashion brands, sourcing offices, and manufacturers.
* Play a meaningful role in transforming traditional fashion supply chain workflows through AI.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Industry Domain Expertise**

* Provide practical domain knowledge across product development, merchandising, sourcing, sampling, costing, and pre-production activities.
* Explain end-to-end workflows followed by fashion brands, buying offices, and apparel manufacturers.
* Identify differences between brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising operations.
* Document industry terminology, business processes, approval requirements, and operational challenges.

**2. Brand-Side Sourcing & Merchandising Workflows**

* Map how fashion brands manage seasonal collections, product development calendars, style development, and sourcing activities.
* Explain vendor selection, quotation comparison, target costing, and supplier coordination processes.
* Understand how brands coordinate with multiple factories and track product development progress.
* Identify operational challenges in brand-to-manufacturer communication, sample management, and approval tracking.

**3. AI Product Development & Workflow Automation**

* Collaborate with AI engineers and product teams to convert merchandising processes into software requirements.
* **Identify repetitive manual activities suitable for AI-driven automation.**
* Help design AI agents for sampling, costing, technical document processing, approvals, and workflow tracking.
* Validate AI-generated information against actual apparel industry practices.
* Define business rules, workflow exceptions, and scenarios requiring human intervention.
* Provide practical feedback to improve product accuracy, usability, and industry relevance.

**4. Product Testing & Validation**

* Develop realistic merchandising scenarios using tech packs, email conversations, costing sheets, approval documents, and WIP trackers.
* Test AI product features from the perspective of merchandisers, sourcing professionals, and product development teams.
* Identify incorrect interpretations, missing information, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

**5. Customer & Product Collaboration**

* Participate in product discussions, demonstrations, and feedback sessions with apparel manufacturers, buying offices, and brands.
* Understand customer workflows and translate operational requirements into actionable product improvements.
* Work with internal teams to prioritize features based on business value and user needs.
* Support the development of relevant industry use cases and product demonstrations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **Strong practical experience in apparel product development, technical merchandising, sourcing, or buying-office operations.**
* **Good understanding of end-to-end garment development, from initial design brief to bulk production approval.**
* Ability to read and interpret tech packs, BOMs, measurement charts, specifications, and technical comments.
* **Familiarity with brand-to-vendor communication, development calendars, and production handoff processes.**
* Experience working with merchandising trackers, Excel-based WIP reports, and product development documentation.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex garment industry processes clearly to non-fashion professionals, including software engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience with a fashion brand, buying office, sourcing organization, or global apparel exporter.
* Experience coordinating product development across multiple factories or suppliers.
* Familiarity with PLM, ERP, or other apparel industry software platforms.
* Experience creating SOPs, process maps, training materials, or workflow documentation.
* Prior involvement in software implementation, process digitization, or automation projects is an advantage.

*Prior AI or software development experience is not mandatory. Strong apparel industry knowledge and the ability to explain business workflows are more important.*

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

* Help Elimai.ai develop a comprehensive understanding of brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising workflows.
* Translate real-world apparel processes into clear, actionable requirements for AI product development.
* Improve the accuracy and practicality of Elimai's AI-powered merchandising solutions.
* Identify high-value opportunities to automate repetitive work while retaining essential human decision-making.
* Help build products that apparel brands, buying offices, and manufacturers can confidently use in their daily operations.

**Our Values** 




 Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together.
 


* **We Do What We Say:** 
 We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity.

 If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to work with the Director of Product and help set the strategic direction for our Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) product line. This is a senior, high\-impact individual contributor role: you will own the planning and execution for CLM, help shape company\-level bets on where crypto\-agility and CLM automation are headed, and act as the most senior product voice across a portfolio of related modules and initiatives.
 



 You will operate with significant autonomy, partnering directly with engineering leadership, design, sales, and executive stakeholders to translate market and regulatory shifts into a coherent, differentiated roadmap. You will also raise the bar for the broader product organization, mentoring senior and mid\-level PMs, setting standards for discovery and requirements gathering, and representing AppViewX’s CLM strategy with customers, and industry forums.
 



 You bring deep product instincts, sharp executive and customer communication, and strong technical fluency in PKI and certificate management. You are comfortable operating ambiguously at the strategy layer while still being able to go deep into requirements, architecture trade\-offs, and cross\-functional execution when it matters most.
 



 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own the roadmap for Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), aligning it with company strategy, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and enterprise customer needs.
* Act as the senior product strategist for CLM, setting priorities across multiple modules and workstreams and ensuring coherence across the broader product portfolio.
* Lead deep discovery engagements with enterprise customers, PKI architects, and customer stakeholders to surface strategic pain points around certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, discovery, and visibility.
* Translate complex regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, eIDAS, FIPS 140\-2\) into a coherent, forward\-looking set of product capabilities and standards.
* Define AppViewX’s point of view and product response to major industry shifts, including post\-quantum cryptography (PQC), short\-lived certificates (47\-day validity), and Zero Trust models, working closely with engineering and architecture teams.
* Set the bar for product requirements quality across the team, writing and reviewing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the most complex, ambiguous, or cross\-cutting initiatives.
* Mentor and coach senior and mid\-level PMs, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and the overall maturity of product practices, documentation, and process across the organization.
* Collaborate closely with Design on the end\-to\-end experience for certificate discovery, enrollment, renewal automation, and policy enforcement, ensuring consistency across a growing product portfolio.
* Represent AppViewX’s CLM product strategy and roadmap externally with key customers, prospects, and at conferences or forums as needed.
* Influence without direct authority across engineering, design, marketing, sales, and technical field teams aligning diverse stakeholders from individual contributors to the C\-suite around a shared strategic direction.



 Required Qualifications:
 


* 10\+ years of product management experience, including at least 4\+ years operating at a senior/lead or principal level owning strategy for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product.
* Demonstrated track record of owning product strategy end\-to\-end, from market analysis and vision\-setting through execution, launch, and iteration at scale.
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills; experienced with product analytics, cohort analysis, A/B testing, and using data to inform multi\-quarter strategic bets.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication; able to influence senior executives and align cross\-functional stakeholders spanning engineering, design, technical sales, and leadership.
* Significant experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government, telecoms), including direct engagement with security and compliance stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing complex, API\-first products and platform\-level integrations.
* Experience mentoring or leading other product managers, or otherwise operating as a force multiplier for a product organization.



 Domain Expertise (Preferred):
 



 Direct CLM or PKI leadership experience is strongly preferred. Candidates who can demonstrate the following will have a significant advantage:
 


* Deep, strategic understanding of a CLM or PKI management platform, including X.509 certificate standards, certificate authorities (public and private), trust chains, and revocation mechanisms (CRL, OCSP).
* Familiarity with certificate enrollment protocols: ACME, SCEP, EST, and REST\-based CA APIs, and how they shape automation and integration strategy.
* Experience setting strategy for automation workflows, and working knowledge of HSM (Hardware Security Module), key management, and cryptographic policy enforcement at an enterprise scale.



**What’s more in store?** 





 AppViewX is on par with leading global companies when it comes to the benefits it offers its employees, ranging from competitive incentives, health \& wellness policies, saving \& investment schemes, time off/sabbatical eligibility and dedicated L\&D.
 



 What we consider equally important is the flexibility we offer our employees to – work remotely, define their own hours, and more importantly harmonize both work and life. The more trust and accountability we place on our employees, the more they surpass our goals and expectations.

 AppViewX caters to a wide range of customers from Fortune 1000 companies, including six of the top ten global commercial banks, five of the top ten global media companies, and five of the top ten managed healthcare providers. description:
Snapsy – Co\-Founder Opportunity
 



  





 Snapsy Technologies is a young startup, right out of Registration and Pilot Run. We’re looking for someone who wants to help build Snapsy from scratch.
 



  





 What’s Snapsy All About?
 



  





 Snapsy is an on\-demand platform for local human tasks — basically, if you need something done near you, Snapsy connects you with someone reliable who can handle it. No endless searching, no guesswork, no weird surprises.
 



  





 The Problem We’re Tackling
 



  





 In Bangalore (and honestly, plenty of Indian cities), people face tiny but annoying tasks every day. Finding someone trustworthy to help, at a fair price, is almost impossible. Helpers have the skills and want regular work, but opportunities are scattered. We want to fix that, make things easier for everyone.
 



  





 Where We Are Right Now
 



  





 \- We’ve talked to real people and the need is clear.
 



 \- Product: There’s a basic version already running.
 



 \- Traction: Early pilots haven’t started yet. We’re at day zero—which is exactly where builders shine.
 



  





 Building Snapsy Side by Side
 



  





 This isn’t just another job. It’s a chance to start shaping Snapsy from the ground up, right alongside the founder.
 



  





 Who We’re Hoping to Find
 



  





 We want someone who loves building things, likes talking to users, and doesn’t mind figuring stuff out without a rulebook. You should be fine with uncertainty, ready to spend time on the ground in Bangalore (especially for the first 90 days), and be in it for the long haul.
 



  





 Must haves:
 



 \- Okay with figuring things out on the fly and with limited resources.
 



 \- Willing to be in Bangalore, boots on the ground, for at least the first 90 days.
 



 \- Comfortable with uncertainty, ready to do whatever needs doing.
 



 \- Fully committed to building this over 5–10\+ years.
 



  





 Nice to haves:
 



 \- Experience taking something from zero to one.
 



 \- Knows how Bangalore actually works at street level.
 



 \- Has worked directly with helpers or customers.
 



  





 Equity\-Only, Full Transparency
 



  





 \- Compensation: Right now, just equity.
 



 \- Runway: We’re keeping it lean on purpose.
 



 \- Risk: No promises about salary, funding, or revenue yet.
 



 \- Reward: Meaningful, founder\-level equity. This is for the long run.
 



  





 What "Success" Means in the First 90 Days
 



  





 Forget scaling for now. If we can get these things repeating smoothly together, we’re winning:
 



  





 Who This Isn’t For
 



  





 Skip this if:
 



 \- You’re after a steady paycheck right now.
 



 \- You treat this as a side hustle—not going to work, full\-time only.
 



 \- You don’t like getting your hands dirty or being on\-ground.
 



 \- You want guarantees about revenue, funding, or when a salary shows up.
 



 \- You care more about a fancy title than actually building.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 If this makes your heart race (in the good way), reach out.
 



  





 Email: \[hello@snapsy.co.in]
 



 Subject: "Co\-founder: \[Your Name] – Snapsy"
 



  





 Include:
 



 1\. A quick note on why you actually want this.
 



 2\. One real example where you got something done with almost nothing (if you’ve got numbers, actions, results, share them).
 



 3\. A task or category in Bangalore we could test, and your plan for getting 5 paid customers and 5 helpers in a week.
 



 4\. Your thoughts on equity\-only right now, and your commitment for the next 5–10\+ years.
 



  





 No generic cover letters. Tell us how you’d jump in, not just what you’ve done.
 



  




* We’re not sugarcoating. We’re just being straight with you. If that’s exciting, let’s build Snapsy together.
